title: Chapter 461: Youquan Mountain Appears
content:
Chapter 461: Youquan Mountain Appears

The other ghosts were a little panicked when they saw this.

They naturally felt that their companions were dead.

This scares them.

But Wang Shuo did not give them time to fear and began to attack again.

Wait until the second ghost is absorbed by Rhubarb.

The boss opposite finally couldn't sit still.

"You dare to kill my brother, are you tired of living?"

Wang Shuo chuckled: "Don't worry, it will be your turn later."

Just get rid of these ghosts that are only at the senior warrior level.

Then Wang Shuo, Dahuang and the others took action together. Wang Shuo felt that dealing with the king's ghost was like searching for something.

As one ghost after another was killed by Dahuang, the remaining ones began to beg for mercy. Even the boss of the Blood River Gang began to give in.

But Wang Shuo was unmoved. If he could just beg for mercy and say a few words of submission, he could escape death and the world would be peaceful.

Finally, only the Blood River Gang boss was left.

"What do you want? I won't hold you accountable for killing my men now. From now on, we will keep the same."

Wang Shuo smiled, is this guy mentally retarded?

"Hey, you don't seem to understand the situation now!"

"Don't think that just a few of you can deal with me. I also have a back-up, so don't let the whole thing fall apart when the time comes."

The Blood River Gang boss threatened.

Wang Shuo touched his chin and stared at the other party for a long time, feeling a little unsure.

But no matter what, it is impossible to be scared off by the other party.

"If you have any means, feel free to use them. Let's make plans."

The Ice Phoenix Emperor used ice sealing, the Demon Emperor then breathed out a mouthful of flames, Wang Shuo used his ultimate move, dragon shadows filled the sky, and Rhubarb began to suck souls.

After one operation, the boss of the Blood River Gang was immediately in a panic.

"You forced me to do this."

"Back off, back off, back off!!!"

He shouted several times at Wang Shuo and others, and then emitted a deathly aura like ink, disturbing everyone's sight.

When Wang Shuo dispersed the fog, the other party's figure was nowhere to be seen.

"What the hell, you ran away?"

Wang Shuo never expected that the other party wouldn't even ask for a tombstone and ran away.

Wang Shuo laughed in anger. He held a spear, pointed it at the tombstone of the Blood River Gang boss, and started smashing it.

Wang Shuo didn't know if he could smash the tombstone with his current strength.

"Boom, boom, boom!"

Wang Shuo smashed it for a while and found that only a shallow mark was left on it, which made Wang Shuo a little helpless.

"Marius, come and try it."

The Demon King first burned it with dragon flames. After finding that it had no effect, he waved his claws and smashed it, but it still couldn't be destroyed.

It seems that this kind of black tombstone is not so easy to be damaged.

As for the white tombstones next to them.

It took Wang Shuo a certain amount of time to break it, and Narisi only needed a few hits to break it.

But Wang Shuo did not destroy them all.

This kind of thing doesn't mean much to him.

The task is almost completed.

Wang Shuo began to look for Youquan Mountain.

But no trace of Youquan Mountain was ever found.

A few days later, Wang Shuo finally completed the task.

At this moment, he easily saw a mountain peak.

Presumably, this is Youquan Mountain!

Wang Shuo walked straight towards the mountain peak.

At the foot of the mountain, countless bones are piled up, which is shocking.

On the mountain peak, there are circles of winding trails.

Youquan Mountain is a solitary peak, like a bamboo shoot, reaching into the sky.

The entire mountain was dark in color, and there was a gray sky all around.

Wang Shuo walked alone on the path and struggled to climb up.
